item.title: Self-Hosted PostgreSQL Logical Replication: pglogical vs wal2json vs pgoutput
item.description: PostgreSQL offers two replication paradigms: physical (streaming) replication, which copies entire database clusters byte-for-byte, and logical replication, which replicates individual tables, rows, and columns at the SQL level. While physical replication is ideal for read scaling and disaster recovery, logical replication enables selective data synchronization, multi-master setups, zero-downtime migrations, and change data capture (CDC) pipelines.
